correctness.rationale: Exact cyclic Green recurrence and Rademacher pair covariance give the precise objective. The Hadamard-square Green circulant has strictly smallest Fourier eigenvalue only at the Nyquist frequency, and the alternating binary vector attains the Rayleigh minimum with uniqueness. The residual variance and strict equal-cost comparator follow from finite geometric identities; limiting regimes follow from r in (0,1). 33,861 exact-rational finite assertions passed, separate from the universal analytic proof.

value.rationale: A priori graph-distance coloring is not the same as variance minimization against arbitrary partitions of a dense inverse. The result proves screening-uniform unique global optimality for a standard sparse periodic resolvent, an exact cost-matched advantage over unstructured Hutchinson estimation, and sharp large-cycle and near-singular limits. These provide a mathematically motivated structural benchmark for numerical inverse-trace estimation.
